This document explores mallard duck movement patterns.

```{r}
#| message: false
library(tidyverse)
library(sf)
```

```{r}
#| cache: true
mallards <- readRDS("data/mallards.rds")
```

```{r}
#| warning: false
#| message: false
mallards_sf <- mallards |>
  filter(lat >= 46, lat <= 55, long >= 7, long <= 25) |>
  st_as_sf(coords = c("long", "lat"), crs = 4326)

world <- ne_countries(scale = "medium", returnclass = "sf")

ggplot() +
  geom_sf(data = world, fill = "lightgray", color = "gray50") +
  geom_sf(data = mallards_sf, aes(color = duck_id), size = 0.3, alpha = 0.7) +
  coord_sf(xlim = c(7, 25), ylim = c(46, 55)) +
  labs(
    title = "Mallard GPS fixes in the study region",
    x = "Longitude",
    y = "Latitude",
    color = "Duck"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```
